events.context: Demerzel commit 3ec5110 — 'harness engineering as a first-class direction'. Reframes the Path C end-to-end Phase 1 as the first increment of a Fowler-style harness substrate. Introduces 4-tier trust model and per-producer math-space assignment.
Demerzel commit 7bbe233 — 'harness adapter pattern + tars projection spec'. Specifies how external tooling projects into the harness with explicit adapter contracts.
Demerzel commit 0879f21 — 'cargo harness adapter projection spec'. Concrete adapter spec for Rust workspaces.
Demerzel commit 65fc46c — 'harness signature layer design v0.1'. Adds typed signatures so adapters compose.
Demerzel commit 483cea9 — 'clippy + github-actions + ga adapter projection specs'. Three concrete adapters demonstrating reuse.

ix commit 5699d6c — 'wire deterministic control flow (harness engineering)'. ix consumed the spec and wired the first hook substrate. Closes the propose→consume loop. This is the strongest cross-repo validation since memristive-markov.

ix commit fbcc247 — 'add sentrux as 5th federation peer (realtime structural sensor)'. Sentrux operationalises the harness signature layer — a structural sensor is a typed adapter producing telemetry into the harness. Pattern proven reusable.
ix commit f3d3de3 — 'sentrux: architectural rules + lock current quality as regression gate'. The harness substrate now owns its own quality gate. Self-bracing achieved.

effectiveness.proposition: Harness engineering is the right level of abstraction for Demerzel's substrate work — propose-in-Demerzel/validate-in-consumer cycle closed within 12 days, three concrete adapters shipped, ix self-braced with regression gate.
